q2_gaps: complex multi-word preposition in an oblique ("in the face of") — the oblique rule names the single surface preposition actually used, and CamelCase joining of a multi-word form is specified only for connectives
conventionalized figurative PP ("laugh in the face of danger" = act unafraid) — the idiom coherence test gives no routing when the fixed phrase is a PP rather than a verb+object symbol
notes: The bare-plural verbal generic correctly takes the distributing rule (not a kind-level relation, since the second argument is a PP rather than a bare object NP), with the Skolem-function event, Agent on the volitional intransitive subject, 0.9/0.9 characteristic-disposition strength and no QuantifierPhrase.
